title: Total copies owned
statementMd:
How many physical copies does the library own in total?

Expected columns: `total_copies`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT SUM(copies) AS total_copies FROM books;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
